verdict.rationale: No official SDK is documented anywhere in the evidence. The only programmatic surfaces are a probed OpenAPI spec at docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json and an official CLI, so developers could build against the API or generate their own clients, but not against first-party SDKs. Missing for 10: any official language SDKs (e.g. TypeScript/Python), SDK documentation and versioning, and independent or hands-on evidence of building integrations programmatically.
